name: warpdecode_r4_f16_tree_reduce_gate_up_contract

index_contract.warp: j = block_idx.x * 8 + warp_id ; owns intermediate neuron j in [0, INTER)
index_contract.pair: l = block_idx.z ; token t = l / top_k ; expert e = eids[l]
index_contract.lane_kblock: blk = lane + 32*m for m=0.. while blk < scale_blocks(448) ; lane in [0,32)
index_contract.word: w0=2*blk, w1=2*blk+1 ; packed uint8 word in [0, packed_hidden/8)

reduction: within-block: gv = gw0*xw0 + gw1*xw1 (8-wide F16 SIMD); tree (gv0+gv1)+(gv2+gv3) etc depth 3; scalar gsh -> F32 gacc += gsh*sfg*sfx per block; warp butterfly reduce 32 lanes

obligations.label: neuron in range
obligations.claim: 0 <= j < INTER for every launched warp
obligations.status: holds by grid ceil_div(INTER,8) and j<INTER guard

obligations.label: F16 within-block precision
obligations.claim: 16-element F16 partial sum then F32 accumulate preserves cosine vs FP32 ref
